name: Myanmar National STEM Excellence Scholarship
eligibilityCriteria: Top matriculation scorers in Mathematics and Science (> 500 total marks).
description: Covers full tuition fees and monthly living stipend for high-achieving STEM students enrolled in public technology institutes.

name: UIT Future Innovators Tech Grant
eligibilityCriteria: Admitted to B.C.Sc. or B.C.Tech. at UIT with outstanding Math score (> 85).
description: Provides laptop allowance and partial tuition coverage for promising software engineering candidates.

name: ASEAN Undergraduate Fellowship Program
eligibilityCriteria: High academic standing with strong leadership potential and proficiency in English.
description: Prestigious fellowship for outstanding Myanmar students pursuing degrees in Science, Economics, or Law.

name: Victoria International Women in Tech & Business Award
eligibilityCriteria: 50% tuition reduction for female applicants entering IT or Business undergraduate degrees.
description: Empowers female high-school graduates entering computer science or business administration.
